summary: Decouples numerical perception from question reasoning with a tool-built perception state, memory, an evidence loop and a cost-aware RL tool selector for time series question answering; it beats same-backbone baselines on the source benchmark and in zero-shot transfer to five unseen benchmarks, with tool and memory ablations and a cost analysis.
